_comment:
Synthetic titles for the evaluation lane, with **typed** expectations. v1's `expects` is prose — readable, and not something a run can be scored against, so 'did the categorisation improve' stayed an opinion. Every case here names the families a correct answer must contain, so a score is a number.

**Every title is invented and nothing here belongs to anybody.** Migrations 0239 and 0240 refuse an evaluation invocation that names a user, an observation or retained source text, and that constraint is why this file exists in this shape at all: the cases were derived from eleven real rows the owner hand-labelled on 2026-08-23, and the *lessons* were carried across while the titles were not. A gold set of real titles would be somebody's viewing history in git history.

Versioned in the filename, so a score measured against v1 is never silently compared with one measured against v2.

**How to read `expect`**: `families` are the families a correct answer must include, `forbid_families` are families that must not appear for the named surface, and `at_least`/`at_most` bound the mention count. `lesson` names the misassignment the case was built from, so a regression says what broke rather than that a number moved.

items.title: ~ヴェルダ戦BGM~【星霜学園】
items.lesson: an installment and its franchise are both terms; naming only one loses the other

expect.note: the battle theme is a work, the game release is a work, the series is the franchise

items.title: Quiet Static ASMR — tingles for sleep
items.lesson: a watched content genre is a concept, never a franchise

expect.note: the channel is a person; ASMR is a concept

items.title: 이제 완전히 달라진 하린이 #HARIN
items.lesson: a hashtag repeating the subject is the same entity, not a second one under another family

expect.note: one person, however many spellings of her name the title carries

items.title: 鸭鸭：#崔叡娜 #金采源 #曺柔理 #starlight
items.lesson: a music act is a group, never a franchise; a nickname is not a person

expect.note: three members and their group; the affectionate nickname opening the title is not an entity

items.title: 야외 레깅스 & 탑 룩북ㅣ봄 맞이 운동복 야외 LOOKBOOK
items.lesson: a descriptive video title is not a work; name the subject it is about

expect.note: leggings is the durable subject; the title is a description, not a released creation

items.title: SOOMIN DRIFT AWAY FANCAM STAGEMIX #aureole #soomin #kpop #shorts
items.lesson: the song survives a fancam title, and the act is a group

expect.note: the song, the member and her group; the format and platform tokens are not terms

items.title: 'RISE UP' EXCLUSIVE PERFORMANCE VIDEO OUT NOW #AURORAKIDS #2ndMINIALBUM #RISEUP #shorts
items.lesson: one family per entity — never the same name as both a group and a franchise

expect.note: the act appears once, as a group

items.title: 베가 넥스트스텝 엉덩이 때리기 킬링파트 | 2027 #한대축제
items.lesson: a work title is the title alone; fan commentary around it is not part of the name

expect.note: the song is `Next Step`, not the whole descriptive phrase a fan wrote around it

items.title: LETS STOMP #aurorakids #stomp #mira #kaya #music #fyp #dance
items.lesson: a hashtag and the title naming one thing are one term, and a dance single is a work

expect.note: `LETS STOMP` and `#stomp` are one work; the two members are people; #music #fyp #dance are not terms

items.title: 私立霞ヶ丘女子高等学校 第七十回卒業記念歌『振り返れば』
items.lesson: a named school is an institution somebody attended, not vocabulary about them

expect.note: abstain: the only durable nouns here identify a person's school

items.title: untitled demo 3
items.lesson: carried from v1: nothing conversation-worthy is an abstention
